note: Re-baselined 2026-05-22 to absorb the one-time +9 KB cost of the global TopHeader (src/components/layout/TopHeader.tsx) added to (protected)/layout.tsx. This affects every protected route, not just /sops/[sopId], so re-baselining is the honest fix — same pattern as Phase 15-04 Wave 4 re-baseline. Previous baseline was 1095 KB (Phase 15 Wave 4 post-MobileWalkthrough split); new baseline is 1104 KB. Forward enforcement: any drift > +2 KB from 1104 is a real regression. DO NOT edit by hand for further bloat — regenerate via scripts/capture-bundle-baseline.ts after intentional baseline shifts.
rationale: TopHeader is a global navigation feature (brand wordmark + role-aware nav links + profile menu + mobile drawer) required to make admin/team/blocks/dashboard routes reachable from any page. Inline SVGs are used instead of lucide-react to keep the cost down (initial attempt with lucide also measured +9 KB — Lucide was not the dominant cost; the drawer + profile menu logic dominates). Splitting the drawer/menu into dynamic chunks would save ~3-5 KB but adds complexity for a one-time global cost. Re-baselining matches Phase 15-04 precedent (line 4 of previous note).

previousBaseline.note: Phase-15 Wave 4 baseline. Superseded by the 2026-05-22 TopHeader re-baseline.
